valor: Una denuncia: el mayor porcentaje de tierra de Colombia está en manos de una cantidad mínima de personas. A partir de ahí, el documental retrata y sigue a los movimientos campesinos antilatifundistas, en un manifiesto tejido con voces, datos y registros, dialéctico en su montaje y marxista en su teoría.

valor: An indictment: the largest share of Colombia's land is in the hands of a tiny number of people. From there, the documentary portrays and follows the peasant movements against large landowners, in a manifesto woven from voices, data and records, dialectical in its editing and Marxist in its theory.

antes.ficci-65: Drawing from the denunciation of the land ownership gap in the country, and through a portrait and follow-up of anti-latifundist social movements, Martha Rodríguez and Jorge Silva weave a complex manifesto of voices, data, and records.
